extracted.summary: A centrally sponsored pre‑matric scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students in Goa studying Class 9 or 10, providing financial assistance.
extracted.amount_text: Day Scholars: INR 2,250 annually plus an INR 750 books or ad hoc grant. Hostelers: INR 5,250 annually plus an INR 1,000 books or ad hoc grant. Additional Divyangjan allowance: INR 800 per month for hostelers or INR 600 per month for day scholars.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual family income of less than INR 2,50,000.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be a regular full-time student in Class 9 or 10 in a government or recognised school.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be a domicile of Goa.
